title: melicope viticina
intro: Melicope viticina, commonly known as the Yellow Haw, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating fever, coughs, and other respiratory issues. The health benefits of Melicope viticina include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and limonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
